lines.say: recombinant human FSH, the hormone it makes, given from outside
with hCG, started sperm production in 43% to 80% of men with low LH and FSH (small trials)
gonadotropins raised pregnancy 7% to 16% in unexplained male infertility (weak, off-label)
in women who weren't ovulating, 58% ovulated in the first cycle and 81% by the third
LH, FSH and testosterone checked first, to confirm a pituitary cause
ovarian hyperstimulation, which can turn serious fast, and multiple pregnancies
blood clots in veins or arteries, likelier with clotting risk factors
in men, breast enlargement in 6%; one case needed surgery
in men, acne in 27% and injection-site pain in 11%

ask: Do my hormone tests show a pituitary cause, so that FSH with hCG could work for me?
